design_philosophy: A highly kinetic, ultra-premium Bitcoin wallet inspired by CRED. It combines Neo-Brutalism (bold typography, oversized numbers) with Dark Luxury (deep blacks, glassmorphism, matte gold accents). Interactions should feel physical and rewarding, using gamification principles for everyday actions.

layout.border_radius: rounded-2xl for primary cards, rounded-full for buttons
layout.navigation: Bottom floating glassmorphic tab bar with glowing active states.

pages_and_features.name: Splash / Lock Screen
pages_and_features.description: App entry point. Displays a glossy logo, followed by a biometric/PIN pad lock. Kinetic haptic animations on key press.
pages_and_features.layout: Flex column, centered. Oversized PIN display dots.

pages_and_features.name: Dashboard (Home)
pages_and_features.description: The main wallet view. Shows total balance (Fiat + BTC), 24h change, and a CoinGecko powered price chart (Recharts/Visx). Features a 'Bitcoin Score' gauge (Credit Score style).
pages_and_features.layout: Hero balance at the top with large font. Chart integrated seamlessly into the background. Action grid (Send, Receive, Pay Bills) beneath it.

pages_and_features.name: Send / Receive flows
pages_and_features.description: Drawer modals. Receive: Neon-styled QR code, tap to copy address. Send: Address input -> Amount -> Fee selector (Slow, Average, Fast) -> Swipe-to-confirm -> PIN verification.
pages_and_features.layout: Bottom-up progressive disclosure. Clean, distraction-free inputs.

pages_and_features.name: Rewards Center
pages_and_features.description: CRED-style gamification. Users earn 'Satoshis' or 'BitCoins' for transactions. Daily streak tracker. A 'Claim' button with physics-based coin drop animations.
pages_and_features.layout: Bento grid of available rewards, streaks, and mystery boxes.

pages_and_features.name: Rewards Store (Catalog)
pages_and_features.description: Marketplace to spend earned coins on brand vouchers.
pages_and_features.layout: Vertical list or carousel of visually rich, image-heavy voucher cards.

pages_and_features.name: Transaction History & Activity
pages_and_features.description: List of sent, received, and rewards events.
pages_and_features.layout: Minimalist list with clear positive (green) and negative (white) amounts. Status indicators (Pending/Confirmed).

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use 'framer-motion' heavily for all interactions (button presses, page mounts, bottom sheets).
Use '@phosphor-icons/react' (Duotone or Regular weight) for ultra-premium minimalist iconography.
For the Bitcoin Score gauge, use recharts 'RadialBarChart' or a custom SVG gauge with a golden gradient stroke.
Implement the layout as a mobile-sized container centered on desktop (max-w-md), but make it strictly 'app-like' with no browser scrolling (h-screen, overflow-hidden on body).
Do NOT use generic blue or purple gradients. Stick strictly to black, off-white, and matte gold.
Build a custom bottom navigation bar that floats above the content with backdrop-blur.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, inputs, tabs, and critical UI elements for testing.
For numbers (balances, BTC amounts), use a monospace font (like Space Grotesk) to align decimals perfectly.
Integrate the CoinGecko API (mocked if necessary) for the 1H/24H/7D/1Y chart. Use Recharts with a simple line chart, hiding axes, making it a pure 'sparkline' style.
